selection: Fix all conditions before scoring. Use no accepted answer or candidate score for geometry, segmentation, or vector preparation.
services: Use existing SAM3 and SigLIP2 services on the owner GX10. Send serial requests. Start no separate model process. Preserve at least 20 GiB available and the active 6c and 6d worker.
artifacts: Build two private label embedding indexes and cluster artifacts. Export eight Workbench runs. Preserve all shared indexes.
timing: Accuracy experiment. Reused model answers and component times do not measure production latency.
reference_resize: Preserve each frozen reference resize rule. Label close-ups bypass the 1024-pixel resize. Verify every original gallery input against the frozen index image.
geometry_renderer: Rotate label RGB pixels and the foreground mask together. Use the rotated mask to crop. RGB is already on white. Do not apply its soft alpha a second time.
